cwe_descriptions: CWE-119: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer — The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but it reads from or writes to a memory location outside the buffer's intended boundary. This may result in read or write operations on unexpected memory locations that could be linked to other variables, data structures, or internal program data.

CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime — The product does not sufficiently track and release allocated memory after it has been used, making the memory unavailable for reallocation and reuse.
